description: SYNTHETIC hard cases for categories that real Slack data covers thinly: 'tag' used as a verb or for the product, talk about Tag, and Tag-to-bot chatter. Written by hand, not taken from any workspace. Keep separate from real data: report as its own subset and never use it to set a threshold. Format and labelling rules as conversations.json; the assistant is named 'Tag', so most cases name it and reach the classifier.
